scope: Frontend transient owned-turn GET recovery only; no genuine model/provider/cloud calls by this implementation owner

contract.bound: One exact owned turn ID; three read retries total across the entire turn, not per poll
contract.deadline: Original performance.now monotonic120seconds from interactive request start, never extended; fetch abort uses remaining deadline
contract.cancellation: Active turn ID and interaction epoch checked before/after reads, waits and completion; cancellation cannot restore stale UI
contract.write_policy: No turn-creation POST, observation confirmation, other mutation or inference replay is retried

red_evidence.native_deadline_rounding_failure: Native setTimeout fractional rounding originally permitted two GETs instead of one; the original-deadline abort latch now terminates without a retry.

verification.browser_worker: Explicit deterministic no-model fixture; transport/error/completion payloads controlled only in four new cases
verification.typescript: passed after all four new browser cases were written
verification.backend: Prior256passed reused: backend unchanged; source hash checked
verification.deadline_abort: Native hanging fetch aborted at original100ms test deadline; the original-deadline abort is latched across the turn. Exactly one GET, explicit408, no retry.
verification.browser_qualification: Full37case run passed before native deadline latch; after the latch-only API change all four affected polling browser cases passed. Other33cases reused because this change is scoped to timeout recovery.

limitations: Controlled transport recovery proves client behavior, not uninterrupted real-provider/network availability
